verdict.rationale: Jan's local OpenAI-compatible server documents GET /v1/models and POST /v1/chat/completions, and its docs say users can 'switch freely between local and frontier models.' That implies several models are available and selectable, but nothing explicitly shows models being loaded or swapped on a running server without a restart. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of hot-swapping or per-request model selection on the running server, loading multiple models at once, load/unload controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
